Mechanical Engineering BS at Rice University

What Rice University asks of applicants to Mechanical Engineering BS for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All Rice University courses · Engineering field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • SAT or ACT recommended, not required — applicants without scores get full consideration
  • No preference between SAT and ACT; superscored

The page carries 2026–2027 essay prompts and interview information, so the policy applies to the current cycle.

Verified19 Oct 2026Rice: First-Year International Applicants · Rice: First-Year International Applicants
English language
  • Applicants whose first language is not English must demonstrate English proficiency: at least two years of full-time study in an English-language curriculum before applying, or an official test score
  • Minimum scores:
    • TOEFL iBT 100 (before January 21, 2026) or 5.0 (on/after January 21, 2026)
    • IELTS 7
    • Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency 185
    • Duolingo 130
Verified19 Oct 2026Rice: First-Year International Applicants · Rice: First-Year International Applicants
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

Verified19 Oct 2026Rice: First-Year International Applicants
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: At a minimum, students must complete 16 credits — English 4, social studies 2, mathematics 3, laboratory science 2, one foreign language 2, plus 3 additional credits in these areas. At a minimum, the natural science and engineering divisions require trigonometry or pre-calculus, and both chemistry and physics (a second year of chemistry or biology may substitute for physics). Students on an international curriculum without a foreign-language option (e.g. GCE/A-levels) are exempt from the foreign-language requirement. Computer Science is in Rice Engineering and Computing; Rice admits students to the university as a whole, not to the CS programme.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Rice: First-Year International Applicants · Rice Computer Science: Undergraduate Admission · Rice: Department of Computer Science
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
Schools may submit predicted A-Level results for admission consideration; students are expected to complete the exams and submit final results before enrolling. Applicants on international exam-based curricula must submit final exam results already taken (e.g. IGCSE/GCSE) and predicted results if available.
Verified19 Oct 2026Rice: First-Year International Applicants · Rice: First-Year International Applicants
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
Schools may submit predicted IB Diploma scores for admission consideration; students are expected to complete the exams and submit final results before enrolling. IB exam scores may also be self-reported (optional).
Verified19 Oct 2026Rice: First-Year International Applicants · Rice: First-Year International Applicants
Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: AP (and AICE) exam scores are optional and may be self-reported in the Common App testing section
Verified19 Oct 2026Rice: First-Year International Applicants
Other requirements
  • Rice writing supplement required (short essays plus “The Box” image)
  • Recommendations from your counselor and two teachers required
  • Interview recommended but optional and not guaranteed (virtual in 2026–27); InitialView interviews optional for international students
